name: Shisui (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shisui town emblem in blue: an outlined ring crossed by a diagonal line forming a sail-like triangle, with the character 酒.
history: Municipal flag of Shisui, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 April 1965.

features.role: Shisui town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a diagonal line forming a sail-like triangle, with the character 酒
